thread:
gabe: deploy-bot is recommending an auto-revert for the v3.4 canary in us-west, p95 +29% on /embeddings. Need a human decision: let auto-run or try a config toggle + targeted pin?
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 +29% vs baseline. Auto-revert threshold breached (p95_delta >= 20%). Suggested action: trigger-auto-rollback. Telemetry: [link].
oncall-ela: Oncall here. Any 5xxs or CS reports?
gabe: No 5xx surge, two CS mentions but not widespread. We did flip a new kernel flag and enabled experimental batching; KVcache miss rate jumped.
syl: If errors are flat, a full revert is noisy. We could flip the batching flag back to safe-mode in us-west and/or pin embeddings to last-stable for a small slice to validate. That would suppress auto-revert if manual mitigation is applied.
release-owner: I prefer minimal blast radius. Approve manual mitigation if oncall signs off.
ops-bot: POLICY: Manual mitigations (config flip or partial routing pin) during change windows require approval from oncall + release-owner. Applying manual mitigation will suppress deploy-bot auto-revert.
oncall-ela: I approve trying a config flip first (runtime.batch_mode -> stable) and then a 30% embeddings pin if needed. Gabe, you own release notes. Syl, can you flip the flag?
syl: Running command: `rwctl feature set --name=runtime.batch_mode --value=stable --env=us-west --reason="canary p95 spike"`
syl: Change submitted; propagating (~45s). Monitoring p95, kvcache_miss, and queue depth.
deploy-bot: ACTION: runtime config change detected: runtime.batch_mode=stable in us-west. Auto-revert suppressed while manual mitigation active.
syl: Observability: p95 dropped ~20% on affected endpoints within 60s; KVcache miss reduced for nodes with reverted config. Overall p95 still ~6% above baseline.
gabe: Good partial improvement. Let's pin embeddings back to 1.9.4 for 30% then ramp if it helps.
release-owner: Approved. Oncall, you still good to proceed?
oncall-ela: Approve embeddings pin for 30% slice. If overall p95 not within 10% of baseline after ramp, we will execute a full revert.
syl: Executing: `rwctl route pin --service=embeddings --version=1.9.4 --scope=30% --ramp=60s --reason="canary follow-up mitigation"`
syl: Pin applied; ramp to 30% in progress. Monitoring 2x p95 windows.
deploy-bot: ACTION: routing change detected: embeddings -> 1.9.4 (30% slice). Auto-revert suppressed.
syl: Pinned slice p95 dropped ~22% and KVcache miss normalized on that slice. After ramp to 100% (per runbook) overall p95 returned to baseline.
gabe: Excellent. Drafting blurb: "During a staged rollout we observed increased tail latency for embeddings after enabling experimental batching. We rolled back the batching config in us-west and routed embeddings to the previous stable binary (v1.9.4). Rollout is paused while engineering investigates kernel/batching interaction. No widespread customer errors observed."
release-owner: small edit: add that auto-revert was suppressed after manual mitigation.
gabe: Added and posting to #release-notes + pinging CS. Closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: RECORD: manual mitigation (config flip + partial routing pin) executed and approved by oncall and release-owner. Incident state: mitigated.
